opportunities.title: Road to 50: U.S.–ASEAN Rising Stars (2027)
opportunities.organizer: U.S.-ASEAN Center at Arizona State University and U.S. Mission to ASEAN
opportunities.summary: A fully funded U.S.-ASEAN exchange-alumni leadership forum in Jakarta, Indonesia, February 18–19, 2027 (travel February 17–20). Activities include regional strategy challenges, digital economy themes, cross-border team projects, and networking. Application deadline: December 6, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Jakarta/Phnom Penh time. No participation fee; official travel and accommodation support for selected participants. NOT a general undergraduate opportunity: qualifying prior U.S. government exchange alumni status is required.
opportunities.eligibility: Must be an alumnus/alumna of an eligible U.S. government exchange program (e.g., YSEALI, Fulbright, IVLP), age 20–40, an ASEAN citizen residing in ASEAN, with relevant professional experience, demonstrated community impact/leadership, English proficiency, and availability for the full program. Check complete official criteria before applying.

opportunities.title: Obama Foundation Leaders Asia-Pacific 2027–2028
opportunities.summary: An eight-month virtual values-based leadership development program for emerging changemakers, planned September 2027–May 2028, requiring roughly 8–12 hours a month. No participation fee; no stipend or grant. Priority application deadline: November 23, 2026. Final deadline: December 4, 2026 at noon U.S. Central Time (December 5 at 1:00 a.m. Phnom Penh time). The PMS stores the earlier December 4 date as its calendar deadline because it cannot represent hour/time zone.
opportunities.eligibility: Must reside in an eligible Asia-Pacific country/territory (Cambodia included); meet specified citizenship/residency requirements; be age 24–45 as of September 1, 2027; have 3+ years of relevant leadership/change-making experience, professional English proficiency, an Asia-Pacific impact focus, and availability for program activities. Not intended for students without substantive leadership experience.
